passages.context: Fragment 1 lines 1–9 were inspected with their marked breaks, uncertain letters, alternate reading, and registered 4Q511 parallels. The sequence combines praise, divine power, the first-person Maskil, fear or confounding language, a catalog of hostile beings, harm and cognitive-affliction language, bounded wicked dominion, and renewed praise. This verifies the Qumran-Digital Hebrew architecture, not a complete formula, translation, manuscript-image collation, editorial reconstruction, performance setting, community ownership, efficacy, ordinary practice, diagnosis, influence, continuity, equivalence with Christian exorcism, or operational instruction.
